Synthetic RE10 repair addendum

RE-10 SYNTHETIC QA REPAIR SCOPE, NOT A REAL TRANSACTION. Boise, Idaho. Existing house, ground floor, normal working hours and access. Repair item 1: replace exactly two existing GFCI receptacles with contractor-supplied standard GFCI receptacles at the same locations; include installation and functional testing. Existing wiring is sound. No new circuits. Repair item 2: replace exactly one leaking 1-1/2 inch PVC sink P-trap, including trap, normal fittings, installation and leak testing; existing sink remains. Repair item 3: repair exactly one 12 by 12 inch hole in 5/8-inch Type X drywall, including backing, drywall, tape, compound, sanding and spot priming only. No whole-room painting. Include normal installation supplies, small debris removal and cleanup. Exclude all other work, permits, structural changes and concealed-damage remediation.
